question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5
solution:
The correct answer is '**brink**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the experience of helping people at the edge of life and death.
 
• The appropriate noun should indicate a state of being close to a critical moment or a turning point.
 
• "**Brink**" fits well as it denotes the edge or verge of something, such as death in this context.
 
• Other options ("**longevity**", "**leverage**", "**allowance**") do not fit the context of being close to death.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

 
• *Longevity (दीर्घायु) refers to long life, which doesn't fit the idea of someone being close to death.*
 
• *Leverage (स्रोत) refers to the use of something to gain an advantage, which doesn't relate to the context of death.*
 
• *Allowance (अनुमति) means permission or allowance, which is unrelated to the theme of being near death.*
